mechanism: Isoniazid inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, increasing amiodarone metabolism and potentially decreasing amiodarone levels; additionally, both drugs can cause hepatotoxicity and amiodarone may increase isoniazid levels through CYP2C19 inhibition, leading to isoniazid toxicity.
action: Monitor amiodarone efficacy and toxicity closely; obtain baseline and periodic LFTs and amiodarone levels; consider alternative TB therapy if possible; counsel on signs of hepatotoxicity and arrhythmia.
